promise: King Salman ordered that women be allowed driving licences, effective June 24, 2018.
description: King Salman's September 26, 2017 order allowed driving licences for women. The driving ban ended on the scheduled June 24, 2018 date in Saudi Arabia.
evidence: The royal order establishes the policy and attribution.
The United Nations' June 29, 2018 account confirms that the ban ended on June 24 and that the Secretary-General welcomed its implementation.

promise: We expect Windows 10 to be running on over one billion devices within two to three years
description: At Build on April 29, 2015, Microsoft set a goal of one billion Windows 10 devices within two to three years of availability. It announced more than one billion monthly active devices on March 16, 2020.
evidence: Terry Myerson's April 2015 post records the target.

review.note: Primary announcement authored/presented by Terry Myerson. It was two-to-three years from availability, not June 2018. Billion monthly-active-device milestone came March 2020; replace superlative with measured outcome.
